verdict: Organic presence is active; overdue pipeline milestones remain the priority.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, your Google Business Profiles generated 440 combined actions — 19 calls, 316 direction requests, and 105 web clicks — with no paid media running on any entity. Advance Grinding Services is the bright spot, with Google Business Profile engagement up 7% week-over-week and search visibility up 23% week-over-week. Forte and O'Hare saw Google Business Profile engagement pull back in the most recent 7 days, which we are monitoring; the weekend pattern is a likely contributor but will be confirmed as the new week opens. The more pressing item is a set of CRM, outreach, and web/SEO milestones that have passed their deadlines — resolving these is the direct path to building a paid lead pipeline, and that work is actively being driven to completion ahead of the October 31 target dates.
